findings.issue: Bar chart stacking uses flex-col-reverse but border-radius classes are inverted
findings.evidence: Line 234: flex-col-reverse with line 237: rounded-t on digests (first child, appears bottom) and line 243: rounded-b on lectures (second child, appears top)
findings.consequence: Digests bar displays at bottom with top-rounded corners; lectures bar displays at top with bottom-rounded corners, creating incorrect visual appearance
findings.correction: Either remove flex-col-reverse OR swap rounding: digests should use rounded-b, lectures should use rounded-t
